function: Two-stage channel estimation: ELM denoises received pilots, then FNN/CNN estimates the BS-target-BS sensing channel A and the cascaded BS-RIS-UE communication channel R_k (p. 2, 4).
system: Multi-user RIS-assisted MISO ISAC: full-duplex BS with M=4 antennas, K=3 single-antenna UEs, passive reflecting RIS with N=30 elements; narrowband flat fading, carrier band not stated (p. 2-3, 8).
method: Supervised offline learning: ELM (random hidden weights, pseudoinverse output weights) denoises pilots; then FNN (sensing) and CNN (communication) estimators trained on MSE, Adam optimizer (p. 4-6).
data_channel: Own simulator for training and testing: radar channel A = alpha*a*a^H, Rician BS-RIS (K=10), Rayleigh RIS-UE, log-distance path loss; 10^4 samples per SNR, 90/10 split (p. 8-9).
test_conditions: Train SNR 10:5:20 dB, test SNR -10:2.5:20 dB, 10% held-out simulated data; M and N sweeps use architectures sized by M and N (p. 6, 9-12).
baselines: Learned only: DNN-based two-stage estimator [36] and CGAN-based estimator [38]; ablations: unrefined noisy signal (Fig. 3a) and direct one-stage FNN/CNN (Fig. 4). No LS or MMSE (p. 9-10).
metrics: NMSE (primary) for sensing and communication channels versus SNR, M, N; real additions and multiplications with percentage reduction versus [36]; training and testing runtime per sample (p. 9-13).
complexity: Closed-form counts of real multiplications and additions (Eqs. 32-42); 50-75% reduction (sensing) and 10.5-11.8% (communication) versus [36]; test time 3.6e-5 s/sample at M=16 (p. 7-13).
q1_support: p. 8: "the communication channels follow a Rician distribution" (radar channel A from a steering-vector model, p. 8; path loss p. 9). Custom simulator: no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data; real measurements only as future work (p. 13).
q2_support: p. 9: "the testing phase uses an extended rage of SNR values" is only an SNR sweep. Table II (p. 6) sizes the networks by M and N (input 2MP, 2PC; output 2M^2, 2MN), so each M and N is a separate network; transfer learning is only future work (p. 13).
q3_support: p. 9: "The works in [36] and [38] are adopted as benchmarks", both learned (DNN, CGAN). No LS, MMSE or other non-learned estimator is compared in Figs. 3(b), 4, 7, 8; the Fig. 3(a) baseline is the unprocessed noisy signal (p. 9), not an estimator.
q4_support: p. 7: "The analysis is derived based on the number of real multiplications" and additions; p. 12: "the complexity reduction for real additions ranges from approximately 10.5% to 11.8%"; p. 13 reports measured training and testing times.
q5_support: p. 9: "We allocate 90% of the data for training and 10% for testing" of self-generated simulated data; the paper gives no code or data link, DOI or repository, and uses no public or measured dataset.
notes: Included, area 2 (channel estimation in an ISAC system is area 2). Eligible: learned ELM+FNN/CNN, BS has M antennas and a RIS, quantitative NMSE results. q3 is 0 because both comparisons are with learned methods [36], [38] and no LS or MMSE estimator appears; the Fig. 3(a) raw-signal reference and the Fig. 4 one-stage variant are stage ablations. Reviewer may confirm q3.
